label: Fiber XG
description: Fiber XG (UISP-FIBER-XG) - 1x XGPON (10G downstream / 2.44G upstream) + 1x 2.5G RJ45. The RJ45 jack is also the power inlet: 24 V DC passive PoE (2-pair, 4,5+ / 7,8-), or USB-C 5 V. Max 6 W; there is no PoE output - the vendor lists exactly one PoE interface, "(1) PoE in, 24V DC passive PoE".
notes: Vendor figures, read 2026-11-21 from the tech-spec table, the datasheet PDF (3 pp, text layer) and the US store listing - all three print the same rows. "Networking interface (1) SC/APC, ITU-G.987 XGPON WAN port, (1) 100/1,000/2,500 MbE RJ45 LAN ports"; "PoE interface (1) PoE in, 24V DC passive PoE"; "Max. power consumption 6W"; "Power supply Passive PoE 2-pair (4, 5+; 7, 8-)"; "Supported voltage range 10-30V DC passive PoE". The single RJ45 port is therefore the power INLET, not a PSE: there is no passthrough and no 802.3af/at detection on this box. It is modelled with poeIn 6 (the vendor's max consumption) and no poeOut. Earlier revisions carried `poeOut: true` with `poeOutClass: "PoE"` on eth0, which made the ONU advertise a 1 W 802.3af PSE on the jack it is powered from. PON downstream 9.95 Gbit/s, upstream 2.44 Gbit/s, 20 km reach.
